text:
eli-customer: Hi team — our Private deployment (VPC) stopped showing metrics for tenant `acme-health` in the Console ~2h ago. API calls succeed and traces exist but dashboard shows blank/0 for tokens and latency. Request IDs attached: r:abcd-1234. Help?

maya-support: sorry about that, sending this to infra/SRE. Quick Q: did you recently change any proxy/nginx rules or gateway? any auth errors in the logs?

eli-customer: we didn't touch anything on our side. I ran a quick curl to the metrics endpoint from the private network and see 200 from the ingestion API but the response body is empty: `{"ingested":0}`. our proxy logs show a few 403s earlier around the same time. snippet: 
```
WARN tenant-proxy: missing tenant header, dropping metrics for request /v1/metrics ingestId=abcd
403 POST /v1/ingest - "tenant header required"
```

sam-eng: that log line screams header strip. Are you running a customer-managed proxy that might be normalizing headers? many proxies drop unknown headers by default.

ivan-sre: pinging platform logs for the private control plane. can you paste the exact request you used (with headers masked)? also, what's the `X-Redwood-Tenant` header value you expect?

eli-customer: sure — here's repro (sanitized): 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"seq": ["hi"]}' https://private-ingest.acme.internal/v1/ingest
```
we expect `X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-health` to be forwarded by the proxy. we can confirm the header exists on the incoming request to the proxy but the proxy does not forward it to the control plane.

maya-support: ok that matches a class of incidents where the tenant header was not forwarded through the tenant-routing layer -> control plane auth rejects and the metrics pipeline marks them as not attributed. can infra check if the proxy preserves `X-Redwood-Tenant`?

ivan-sre: looking at the gateway config now. it seems our nginx sidecar had `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;` but NO explicit `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;` so nginx will not pass that custom header unless `underscores_in_headers` or explicit set is configured.

sam-eng: quick mitigation: add this to the ingress conf and reload: 
```nginx
underscores_in_headers on;
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;
```
that preserves the header through the proxy. planning a small rollout to affected gateways.

metrics-bot: [alert] 2025-07-10T14:12:03Z - No metrics observed for tenant=acme-health for 120m. rule_id=tenant-metrics-missing

olivia-platform: if we can't do immediate reload, a temporary reconciliation is to POST tenant id in the backfill API: `POST /admin/backfill?tenant=acme-health` to re-ingest unprocessed payloads (will take ~10-20m to repopulate charts). we should avoid doing that repeatedly.

anya-support: I'm drafting the customer note: "we're investigating missing metrics in your VPC console. root cause looks like a proxy header config; we're rolling a fix and will backfill metrics. ETA 45m." any objections?

ivan-sre: no objections. preflighted the nginx change in staging (k8s helm chart). patch is small and can be rolled with 1% canary. will monitor `tenant-metrics-missing` alerts.

eli-customer: thanks — can you confirm whether this is due to private-side proxy changes? we didn't change anything but our infra team did a cert rotation about the same time.

sam-eng: cert rotation could've caused a config reapply which reverted the explicit header-preserve setting on some gateways. we'll correlate deploy events.

maya-support: action items: 1) ivan to roll nginx header fix to affected gateways (in progress) 2) olivia to run backfill for acme-health once header pass-through confirmed 3) anya to send customer update and ETA 4) sam to add helm chart note to prevent reverts.

ivan-sre: rolling out change now to 3 gateways (canary). watching metrics ingestion logs.

(10m pass)

ivan-sre: canary looks good — `X-Redwood-Tenant` is present in requests to control plane and ingestors are accepting them. metrics ingestion count for acme-health: 0 -> 1200 in last 6m.

metrics-bot: [resolved] 2025-07-10T14:58:10Z - tenant-metrics-missing for tenant=acme-health cleared.

olivia-platform: kicked off backfill job to reconcile the 2h window. dashboard should show historical datapoints in ~15m.

anya-support: sent update to customer with root cause summary and workaround + timeline. customer replied: "Thanks — confirmed charts are repopulating. please keep us posted." :thumbsup:

eli-customer: confirmed — dashboards now show tokens and latency. thanks for fast response. closing on our side.

maya-support: marking thread for postmortem note. sam, can you add helm chart guardrails so header-forwarding is preserved on cert rotations?

sam-eng: yup will add a chart post-apply hook that ensures `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant` exists. Also adding a test that detects header stripping during CI.

maya-support: great. closing thread once postmortem doc is linked. thanks everyone. :heart:
